triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT (BINARY NEW.id <=> BINARY OLD.id) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_at <=> BINARY OLD.created_at) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_by <=> BINARY OLD.created_by) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.deleted <=> BINARY OLD.deleted) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.store_no <=> BINARY OLD.store_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.occupation_no <=> BINARY OLD.occupation_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.owner_no <=> BINARY OLD.owner_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_no <=> BINARY OLD.execution_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.start_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.start_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.payload_hash <=> BINARY OLD.payload_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.planned_resource_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.planned_resource_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.planned_resource_command_hash <=> BINARY OLD.planned_resource_command_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.reference_json <=> BINARY OLD.reference_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.reference_hash <=> BINARY OLD.reference_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.initial_plan_json <=> BINARY OLD.initial_plan_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.plan_hash <=> BINARY OLD.plan_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.result_no <=> BINARY OLD.result_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.result_revision <=> BINARY OLD.result_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.result_hash <=> BINARY OLD.result_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.initial_effects_json <=> BINARY OLD.initial_effects_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.initial_effects_hash <=> BINARY OLD.initial_effects_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.started_at <=> BINARY OLD.started_at) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Immutable resource original';
    END IF;
    IF (OLD.state='ENDED' AND NEW.state<>'ENDED') OR (OLD.state='CLEANING' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('CLEANING','ENDED')) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Occupation lifecycle cannot reopen';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.revision<OLD.revision OR NEW.revision>OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.observation_epoch<OLD.observation_epoch OR NEW.observation_epoch>OLD.observation_epoch+1 OR (NEW.state<>OLD.state AND NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Occupation lifecycle revision required';
    END IF;
END

        NOT (BINARY NEW.command_kind <=> BINARY OLD.command_kind) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.payload_schema <=> BINARY OLD.payload_schema) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_reference_json <=> BINARY OLD.execution_reference_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_reference_hash <=> BINARY OLD.execution_reference_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.planned_resource_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.planned_resource_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.planned_resource_command_hash <=> BINARY OLD.planned_resource_command_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_plan_hash <=> BINARY OLD.execution_plan_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.original_start_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.original_start_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actor_namespace <=> BINARY OLD.actor_namespace) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actor_provenance_hash <=> BINARY OLD.actor_provenance_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.machine_purpose <=> BINARY OLD.machine_purpose) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Resource command kind and original are immutable';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.command_kind='OCCUPATION_V1' AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.store_no <=> BINARY OLD.store_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.command_no <=> BINARY OLD.command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.owner_no <=> BINARY OLD.owner_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.action <=> BINARY OLD.action) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.request_key_hash <=> BINARY OLD.request_key_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.payload_hash <=> BINARY OLD.payload_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.frozen_payload <=> BINARY OLD.frozen_payload) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.initiated_by <=> BINARY OLD.initiated_by) OR NEW.deleted<>0) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Actual command original is permanent';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.command_kind='OCCUPATION_V1' AND OLD.status<>'ACCEPTED' AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.status <=> BINARY OLD.status) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.result_payload <=> BINARY OLD.result_payload) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.original_result_no <=> BINARY OLD.original_result_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.original_result_revision <=> BINARY OLD.original_result_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.original_result_hash <=> BINARY OLD.original_result_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.occupation_outcome <=> BINARY OLD.occupation_outcome) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.seal_no <=> BINARY OLD.seal_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.seal_revision <=> BINARY OLD.seal_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.seal_hash <=> BINARY OLD.seal_hash)) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Original occupation result is permanent';
    END IF;
END

trg_rco_consumed_immutable
triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF OLD.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.unit_no <=> BINARY OLD.unit_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.hold_no <=> BINARY OLD.hold_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.bucket_no <=> BINARY OLD.bucket_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.allocation_revision <=> BINARY OLD.allocation_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.qty <=> BINARY OLD.qty) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.source_line_ref <=> BINARY OLD.source_line_ref) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.consume_occupation_unit_no <=> BINARY OLD.consume_occupation_unit_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.consumed_at <=> BINARY OLD.consumed_at) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.consume_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.consume_command_no) OR NEW.deleted<>0 OR NEW.released_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.release_command_no IS NOT NULL) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Booking consumption is permanent';
    END IF;
END
